en.headline: Space Museum 3D dome show on the solar system ends Wednesday
en.dek: The Great Solar System Adventure 3D at the Hong Kong Space Museum runs until 14 October, with screenings for families and adults.
body: The Hong Kong Space Museum's 3D dome show The Great Solar System Adventure 3D is scheduled to end on Wednesday, 14 October, after running since 15 October 2025.

The 25-minute production takes viewers on a voyage through the solar system, encountering Mercury's temperature extremes, Venus's atmosphere, a landing on Mars, Jupiter's storms, Saturn's rings, and the outer planets, narrated by the character The Great Schiaparelli.

Screenings take place at the Space Theatre in Tsim Sha Tsui. On weekdays the show is at 2pm and 6.30pm; on weekends and public holidays at 12.30pm and 5pm. Admission ranges from HK$15 to HK$40 depending on seating and concession eligibility.

The museum said concession rates apply to full-time students, people with disabilities and one accompanying carer, and senior citizens aged 60 or above. Children aged four and under enter free in some cases, according to venue rules.
The show is produced by NSC Creative. Visitors can check the Space Museum website or box office for any remaining tickets before the final screenings.

zh.headline: 太空館太陽系3D穹幕影院節目周三結束
zh.dek: 香港太空館「太陽系大冒險3D」穹幕影院節目將於10月14日結束，適合家庭及成人觀賞。
body: 香港太空館的3D穹幕影院節目《太陽系大冒險3D》自2025年10月15日起放映，將於本周三（10月14日）結束。
這部長25分鐘的節目帶領觀眾遊曆太陽系，經歷水星極端溫差、金星高壓大氣、登陸火星、木星風暴、土星光環及外行星，由角色「偉大的斯基亞帕雷利」解說。
節目於尖沙咀太空館太空劇場放映。平日下午2時及6時30分各一場，周末及公眾假期則中午12時30分及下午5時。票價視座位及優惠資格而定，介乎15至40港元。
太空館表示，全日制學生、殘疾人士及其一名陪同者，以及60歲或以上長者可享優惠票價。部分情況下4歲或以下兒童可免費入場，詳情以場館規定為準。
節目由NSC Creative製作。有興趣的市民可於最後放映日前查詢太空館網站或售票處了解剩餘門票。
